simWinnerStats.predTop1Is: ALIAS of winP50 — identical expression q(wsSorted,0.50). Same quantity, two names. Never treat predTop1-bearing nights as a distinct era; winP50 carries the same value back to 8/19.
simWinnerStats.predCashIs: ALIAS of cashP50 — identical expression q(cts,0.50). Same quantity, two names. Declared for the same reason as predTop1Is: an undeclared byte-identical pair reads as two measurements.
simWinnerStats.predAbsentWhy: top10/top100/top1pct are field order statistics; this sim block retains only per-sim rank-1 scores and cash lines
